modifiedFiles.commitMessage: Update FIDO2 attestation table to MDS v285

englishSummary.headline: FIDO2 attestation table updated to MDS version 285
englishSummary.summary: The documentation now references MDS version 285 instead of 279 and adds five FIDO2 security key models with their AAGUIDs and capability indicators.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators evaluating FIDO2 key attestation can use the updated model list and identifiers; no configuration change is required.
